description.value: Ohana Poke is a Hawaiian and Japanese fusion restaurant on Fisgard Street in Victoria's Chinatown district, serving poke bowls and fresh cuisine. The restaurant positions itself around healthy, fresh ingredients drawing on both Hawaiian poke and Japanese culinary traditions. It offers online ordering, making it convenient for cyclists wanting a quick, nutritious stop.
